modules.name: Mobile App – Resident
modules.description: The resident-facing mobile app covering registration, complaints, bookings, visitors, documents, family and neighbours.

requirements.title: Self-registration as Owner or Tenant
requirements.description: Residents can self-register as Owner or Tenant and see their approval status.

requirements.title: Raise complaint with photos
requirements.description: Residents can raise a complaint with photos.

requirements.title: Track complaint status and timeline
requirements.description: Residents can track a complaint through its status and timeline.

requirements.title: Approve or reopen fixed complaint
requirements.description: Residents can approve or reopen a complaint that has been fixed.

requirements.title: Book and cancel bookable amenity
requirements.description: Residents can book a bookable amenity such as a hall and cancel the booking.

requirements.title: Book shared facility slot with check in/out
requirements.description: Residents can book a slot for a shared facility such as a gym or pool and check in and check out.

requirements.title: Add expected visitor
requirements.description: Residents can add an expected visitor.

requirements.title: View own visitor history
requirements.description: Residents can view their own visitor history.

requirements.title: My Family management
requirements.description: Residents can add, edit and remove family members under My Family.

requirements.title: Live count of people in shared facilities
requirements.description: Residents can see a live count of people inside each shared facility.

rules.title: Complaints for own flat only
rules.description: A resident can raise a complaint only for their own flat.

rules.title: Society documents view only
rules.description: Residents can only view society documents, not change them.

rules.title: Neighbours: name and occupation only
rules.description: Residents can see only the name and occupation of neighbours on their floor.
